children: CDT Equity updated the terms of its $8 million investment in Sarborg, maintaining its plan to acquire a 20% stake while shifting part of the consideration to stock and extending cash payments through May 31, 2027. The company issued 650,000 shares to Sarborg and will apply ATM proceeds with minimum monthly payments to settle the remaining balance. Separately, CDT Equity raised short-term liquidity via a $541,620 senior secured convertible note with warrants from J.J. Astor & Co., which was fully repaid on September 4, 2026 without any share conversions. The financing and amended investment terms aim to balance strategic growth with liquidity management.
